_about: Copy to watch.json and edit. repo: your repo. identities.ours: your GitHub login(s); the loop and the auto-merge gate treat only these as 'ours'. prs/issues: what to watch, keyed by number; owner is {"session": ..., "terminal": ...} or null for report-only. Your own open PRs that are missing here show up as unwatched_open_prs. See KIT/rules/watcher.md.
